title: Milestone v1
description: A dated delivery boundary that tasks are scheduled against. Infrastructure record only; it schedules work and carries no authority over evidence, verification, or gates.

milestoneId.description: Stable identifier. Distinct from a task id so a milestone can never be mistaken for executable work.

targetDate.description: Intended completion date. A target, never a commitment, and never evidence that work is on schedule.

state.description: AT_RISK is a statement about the schedule, never about the work's correctness. COMPLETE means every task closed or explicitly dropped, not that anything passed verification.

outcome.description: What is true at the end that is not true now.

notInScope.description: The boundary of the milestone. Recorded because omitting it is how scope grows unnoticed.

taskIds.description: Tasks scheduled against this milestone. Membership schedules work; it confers no authority on any task.

completionEvidence.description: What settles that the milestone is done. Absent means unestablished, never done.
